# Taiwan with Kids: Complete 7-Day Itinerary (2026)

Taiwan is one of Asia's most underrated family destinations. Efficient high-speed rail, incredible night markets, stunning nature, and exceptionally friendly locals - all at a fraction of the cost of Japan or Singapore.

## Day 1: Arrive in Taipei

### Afternoon - Check In + Explore Ximending

Ximending is Taipei's youth district - think Shibuya but more relaxed. Pedestrian-only streets, street performers, quirky shops, and endless food options.

### Evening - Dinner at Ximending Night Market

Must-try with kids:
- Grilled squid (chewy, mild, kids love it)
- Taiwanese sausage wrapped in sticky rice
- Bubble tea from a street stall ($1.50 USD)
- Mango shaved ice (bingsoo-style)

### Where to Stay in Taipei

Best family areas: Ximending (central, fun, great food), Daan (quieter, parks, family-friendly)

[Browse Taipei family hotels on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Taipei&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-08&group_adults=2&group_children=2)

## Day 2: Taipei Must-Sees

### Morning - Taipei Zoo + Maokong Gondola

[Taipei Zoo tickets on Klook](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/2896-taipei-zoo/)

One of Asia's best zoos. Lush, well-maintained, affordable ($2 USD entry!). Highlights:
- Giant Panda House (Tuan Tuan and Yuan Yuan)
- Koala exhibit
- Formosan Animal Area (Taiwan's native species)
- Children's Zoo with petting area

From the zoo, take the Maokong Gondola up the mountain. Glass-bottom cabins available (request "crystal cabin"). At the top: tea houses with stunning views.

### Evening - Shilin Night Market

Taipei's largest and most famous night market. Come hungry.

Kid-friendly eats:
- Hot star fried chicken (huge, crispy, addicting)
- Oyster omelette
- Pepper pork buns
- Fried milk (sweet, crispy outside, custard inside)
- Fresh fruit juices

## Day 3: Jiufen + North Coast

### Day Trip to Jiufen (40 min from Taipei)

Jiufen is the mountain town that inspired Spirited Away (Studio Ghibli). Narrow alleys, red lanterns, teahouses.

Must-do:
- Walk Old Street (A-Mei Tea House is iconic)
- Try taro balls (sweet chewy dessert)
- Visit Shengping Theatre (old Japanese cinema)
- Take photos at the viewing platform

[Book a Jiufen tour on Viator](https://www.viator.com/Taipei-tours/Jiufen/d36070-g12?mcid=42383)

### Afternoon - Yehliu Geopark

On the way back, stop at Yehliu Geopark. Incredible rock formations carved by the sea - the "Queen's Head" is the most famous.

Good for 1-2 hours. Wear good shoes - the rocks can be uneven.

## Day 4: Taroko Gorge

### Take the Train to Hualien

High-speed train to Hualien (2 hours from Taipei). Budget-friendly option.

### Taroko Gorge Highlights

[Taroko Gorge tours on Klook](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/408-taroko-gorge-tour/)

Taroko is Taiwan's most famous natural wonder - a marble-walled canyon with turquoise rivers.

Kid-friendly trails:
- Shakadang Trail (flat, 1.5 km, follows the river, great for swimming in summer)
- Baiyang Waterfall Trail (waterfall at the end, fun tunnels to walk through)
- Xiangde Temple Trail (short walk to a temple with great views)

Pro tip: Kids under 12 get free entry to Taroko National Park.

### Evening - Stay at Hualien

Hualien is a relaxed coastal city. Dongdamen Night Market has excellent food and a children's play area.

## Day 5: Sun Moon Lake

### Travel to Sun Moon Lake

Take the train from Hualien to Taichung (3 hours), then bus to Sun Moon Lake (1.5 hours). Or rent a car for the day.

### Sun Moon Lake Activities

[Jump on a Sun Moon Lake tour](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/683-sun-moon-lake-tour/)

- Bike around the lake (one of the world's most scenic bike paths - flat and paved)
- Take the cable car for panoramic lake views
- Visit Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village (theme park + indigenous culture)
- Boat cruise to Ita Thao village (traditional Aboriginal food)

Best for kids: The bike ride. Rent bikes with child seats or tandem attachments. The 12 km loop is mostly flat.

## Day 6: Taichung

### Morning - National Museum of Natural Science

One of Asia's best natural history museums. The dinosaur exhibit is world-class and the Science Center has hands-on exhibits for kids.

### Afternoon - Rainbow Village + Carton King

Rainbow Village: A veterans' village painted in every color by a 90-year-old former soldier. Free entry, great photo spot.

Carton King: Everything is made of cardboard - furniture, decorations, even a cardboard train kids can ride. Bizarre but fun.

### Evening - Fengjia Night Market

Taichung's biggest night market and arguably the best in Taiwan for food variety.

## Day 7: Taipei Final Day

### Morning - Taipei 101 + Elephant Mountain

Visit Taipei 101 (quick elevator up and down - the view is spectacular).

[Book Taipei 101 tickets on Klook](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/881-taipei-101-observatory/)

For active families: hike Elephant Mountain (15 minutes up, 100 steps). Best free view of Taipei 101.

### Afternoon - Dihua Street + Dadaocheng Wharf

Dihua Street is Taipei's oldest street - traditional shops selling dried goods, herbs, and teas. Near Dadaocheng Wharf with a great riverside park and playground.

### Evening - Final Night Market

Hit your favorite night market one last time. Or try Ningxia Night Market (smaller, more traditional, excellent seafood).

## Transportation Tips

- **EasyCard** - Get one at any MRT station. Works for metro, buses, bike share, and convenience stores.
- **High-Speed Rail** - Book 4 weeks ahead for 20% discount. Kids under 6 are free (no seat).
- **Taiwan Tourist Shuttle** - Bus routes connecting all major attractions. Cheap and reliable.
- **Taxis** - Cheap and metered. Uber available in major cities.

## Where to Stay Overall

| Location | Hotel Type | Nightly Rate |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| Taipei | Family hotel | $60-150 |
| Hualien | Guesthouse | $40-80 |
| Sun Moon Lake | Resort | $80-200 |
| Taichung | Business hotel | $50-120 |

## Budget Breakdown (Family of 4)

| Category | 7-Day Cost |
|----------|-----------|
| Accommodation | $350-700 |
| Food | $200-350 |
| Transport | $150-250 |
| Activities | $100-200 |
| Total | $800-1500 |

## The Verdict

Taiwan offers incredible value for families. It combines Japanese-style efficiency with affordable prices and genuinely friendly locals. The 7-day itinerary covers the best of Taipei, Taroko Gorge, Sun Moon Lake, and Taichung.
